name: content-cache.status
title: Status Content Cache Status
description: The status item that reports the status of the Content Cache service.

payloadkeys.title: Status of the content cache service
payloadkeys.content: The basic set of AssetCache status items

subkeys.title: Server GUID
subkeys.content: The unique identifier of the Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Activated
subkeys.content: If `true`, the device has enabled the Content Cache. Enabling the Content Caching doesn't guarantee service. See the `Active` key for the readiness of the Content Cache to serve requests.

subkeys.title: Active
subkeys.content: If `true`, the Content Cache is ready to serve requests.

subkeys.title: Cache status
subkeys.content: The level of cache pressure. `LOWSPACE` means cache pressure is high.

subkeys.title: Private addresses
subkeys.content: An array of the Content Cache's local IP addresses.

subkeys.title: Private address
subkeys.content: Local IP address at which the Content Cache listens for requests from clients, peers, and children.

subkeys.title: Public address
subkeys.content: The public IP address of the Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Port
subkeys.content: The IP port number the Content Cache listens to for requests from clients, peers, and children.

subkeys.title: Registration status
subkeys.content:
The status of the Content Cache's registration with Apple, which is one of the following values:

- `-1`: The registration failed.
- `0`: The registration is pending.
- `1`: The registration succeeded.

subkeys.title: Registration timestamp
subkeys.content: The RFC 3339 timestamp for when the Content Cache began registering itself with Apple. This value is only available during registration attempts.

subkeys.title: Registration response code
subkeys.content: If present, the HTTP response code that the Content Cache received when it failed to register itself with Apple.

subkeys.title: Registration error
subkeys.content: If present, the reason the Content Cache failed to register itself with Apple.

subkeys.title: Startup status
subkeys.content: The status of the Content Cache's registration with Apple.

subkeys.title: Tetherator status
subkeys.content:
The status of tethered caching, which is the Content Cache with a shared internet connection, which is one of the following values:
- '-1' : Unknown
- '0' : Disabled
- '1' : Enabled

subkeys.title: Sending metrics reports
subkeys.content: When present, a value of `true` indicates that the cache is sending metrics reports to the URL specified in the `ManagementStatusTarget` key in the installed `ContentCaching` configuration.

subkeys.title: Metrics report response code
subkeys.content: When present, contains the HTTP response code that the Content Cache received when it failed to send the metrics report to the target URL.

subkeys.title: Metrics report error
subkeys.content: When present, indicates why the Content Cache failed to send the metrics.

subkeys.title: Version
subkeys.content: The version number of the Content Cache software.
